scope: Origin, chronology, independent pre-PGM history, and primary screenshot receipt for the Tarbar/Mramor identity pair.

tarbar.chronology: Nick existed before the 2026 Egyptological/PGM search.
tarbar.later_use: Telegram helper/twink persona participating with Yaks in philosophical discussion with JANUS under posts.

mramor.later_use: Later paired with Tarbar in Telegram for aesthetic composition.

screenshot.note: Binary screenshot is held in the conversation attachment context; this registry record stores its digest and a conservative factual transcription, not the image binary.

visible_chat_facts: A missed call is shown at 20:56.
At 20:58-20:59 the user states that the number was reissued and that another person had previously had the number.
The user states immediately after the call that the previous holder's mother had called.
At 21:00 the user reports that the caller said the previous holder of the number had died about four years earlier and asked where the current user obtained the number.
Another participant in the visible chat says 'I am his wife'.

Research identifies MARMARAUOTH and BARBAREIKH/BARBAREXCH in one invocation, PGM XII.201-269.

pgm_comparison.structural_observation: Two independently-originated modern names later paired together resemble two ancient forms occurring inside the same invocation.
